data.title: Cardano Is Up 16% This Month, Nearly Double Bitcoin’s Gain. Is ADA Finally Turning?
data.description: Cardano has outpaced Bitcoin for months, strung together three consecutive monthly gains, and drawn serious attention at a key price level that could signal either a real recovery or a painful reversal.
